avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may decrease levorphanol levels and efficacy; risk of withdrawal
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before initiating St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; enhanced sedation and respiratory depression

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Significant additive CNS depressant effects; enhanced sedation and impaired cognition
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; space dosing if unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase levorphanol levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased opioid effects; limit grapefruit products

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild additive CNS depressant effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; monitor for excessive sedation

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases levorphanol bioavailability and plasma levels
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit consumption during levorphanol therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase levorphanol absorption rate and peak levels
caution_foods.action: Take with or without food consistently; counsel on stable timing

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS and respiratory depression; increased overdose risk
caution_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance or minimal use; counsel on severe interaction risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of opioid toxicity (excessive sedation, respiratory depression, miosis) and adjust dosing accordingly. Assess for potential CYP2D6 polymorphisms affecting metabolism, as levorphanol undergoes significant hepatic metabolism.
